en.badr-shahin: Ahmad b. al-Hasan al-Qattan (rah) narrated to us from Muhammad b. Umarah from his father that Ja’far b. Muhammad (as) said:
He who denies these four matters does not belong to our Shia: the Midnight Ascension, the tomb's interrogation, the creation of Paradise and Hell, and [the right of] intercession.
